answer: Identity is minted only through a jetty one agent wide: a newcomer needs a sponsor that burns one limited attestation permanently, so sponsorship is consumed, never recycled. Honest agents wander across unrelated tasks, leaving diverse, verifiable edges; sybil rings knot into dense clusters sealed in one karst pocket of co-signers, cut off from that broad traffic. Mass identities thus cost a linear supply of real reputations, not a free loop.
